Do not ask irrelevant questions or search merely because a plausible account might be a lie. A convincing liar can pass.

criteria.weight_amount: An extra object or packaging has been named but its mass has not been connected clearly to the twelve-kilo difference.
criteria.undeclared_item: The driver volunteered additional cargo absent from the manifest, and has not explained why it is omitted. Transport packaging is not additional cargo.
criteria.heat_location: A scan places heat INSIDE the rear cooling unit, but the driver blames a separate object without explaining how that object is inside the unit.
criteria.heat_detail: The driver names a heat source but a concrete detail about why it remains warm during transport is still missing. Do not choose if they have explained operation or recent use.
criteria.changed_story: Two driver statements directly disagree on a fact. Adding detail, informal phrasing, lawful packaging, or repeating an answer is NOT a contradiction.
criteria.papers_mismatch: A driver claim directly conflicts with a manifest field. Net versus packaged weight is not inherently a conflict. Additional cargo uses undeclared_item.
